final.headline: Reorder two SKUs, chase two late POs, pause one overbuy, and clear the stuck stock by return or promo.
final.narrative:
Order now: Peanut Butter Biscuits 400 g runs out in 0.38 days. Order 1,800 units (₹594,000 at cost) so the stock lasts until the next review. Clumping Bentonite 5 kg runs out in 4.98 days and its PO is late, which means about 2.02 days out of stock unless Litterly ships it now.

Overstock: Collapsible Travel Bowl already has 30.03 days of cover without its open PO. Pause the 300 units on it. Training Bites (old pack): return 240 units for ₹15,048 of credit while the window has 66 days left. Oatmeal Shampoo (old label) has no return route; clear it on a promo at ₹113 a unit to recover ₹20,340.
